sentences.text: Dear Golden State Mutual Insurance Co. Claims Department,
Re: Claim number CLM-2026-48213, Policy number CA-AUTO-7731904, 2019 Honda Civic EX, VIN 2HGFC1F35KH654321
I am writing about your total loss offer dated 2026-10-14 for my 2019 Honda Civic EX with 48,200 miles, which totals $17,104.75 with a base value of $17,050.00.
After reviewing the valuation, I respectfully do not accept this offer, for the reasons set out below.

Comparable C1 does not meet the requirement for "Similar trim, options and mileage" under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2): it is an LX trim rather than an EX, it has 61,400 miles compared with my 48,200 miles, and it lacks a Sunroof, Apple CarPlay and Heated Seats.

Comparable C2 does not meet the requirement that a comparable be "Identified by VIN, stock number or plate, with seller contact" under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), because it has no VIN, stock number or plate and no seller contact.
Comparable C2 also does not meet the requirement for "Similar trim, options and mileage" under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), because it lacks a Sunroof, Apple CarPlay and Heated Seats.

Comparable C3 does not meet the requirement that a comparable be "Available locally (100 mi) within 90 days" under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), (b)(4)(A), because it is 214 mi away and was listed 137 days before the offer.
Comparable C3 also does not meet the requirement for "Similar trim, options and mileage" under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), because it lacks a Sunroof, Apple CarPlay and Heated Seats.

The valuation applies a condition deduction of $1,150 even though my vehicle was graded "Average" and no documentation was provided, while 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2) calls for a "Condition deduction only if documented below average."

Under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(4)(A), the "Base value is the average of the comparables," but the C2 mileage adjustment of -400 has the wrong sign (52,000 vs 48,200 mi), and the average of the adjusted values is $17,266.67, not the $17,050.00 stated in the report.
Under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(1), the "Offer includes tax, fees and prorated registration, minus deductible," but your offer is missing prorated registration.
Current market data supports a higher value: a linear fit of price on mileage across 11 current comparable listings gives a market value of $20,457.00 at 48,200 miles.

For example, BMW of Concord, 14 mi away, lists a 2019 Honda Civic EX FWD with 27,670 miles, VIN JHMFC1F3XKX009872, at $23,047.00 (https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/inventorylisting/viewDetailsFilterViewInventoryListing.action?sourceContext=carGurusHomePageModel&entitySelectingHelper.selectedEntity=&zip=94704#listing=462369858/NONE/DEFAULT).

Mistlin Honda, 70 mi away, lists a 2019 Honda Civic EX FWD with 23,107 miles, VIN 19XFC1F36KE204739, at $22,981.00 (https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/inventorylisting/viewDetailsFilterViewInventoryListing.action?sourceContext=carGurusHomePageModel&entitySelectingHelper.selectedEntity=&zip=94704#listing=461854595/NONE/DEFAULT).

Acura of Modesto, 70 mi away, lists a 2019 Honda Civic EX FWD with 36,243 miles, VIN 19XFC1F38KE213250, at $23,699.00 (https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/inventorylisting/viewDetailsFilterViewInventoryListing.action?sourceContext=carGurusHomePageModel&entitySelectingHelper.selectedEntity=&zip=94704#listing=460575836/NONE/DEFAULT).

Envision motorsport, 64 mi away, lists a 2019 Honda Civic EX FWD with 43,394 miles, VIN 19XFC1F38KE210073, at $15,990.00 (https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/inventorylisting/viewDetailsFilterViewInventoryListing.action?sourceContext=carGurusHomePageModel&entitySelectingHelper.selectedEntity=&zip=94704#listing=456058569/NONE/DEFAULT).

Quintero's Auto Sales, 41 mi away, lists a 2019 Honda Civic EX FWD with 207,220 miles, VIN JHMFC1F35KX002716, at $10,900.00 (https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/inventorylisting/viewDetailsFilterViewInventoryListing.action?sourceContext=carGurusHomePageModel&entitySelectingHelper.selectedEntity=&zip=94704#listing=447821466/NONE/DEFAULT).

Accordingly, I request a revised offer of $22,128.84, consisting of a vehicle value of $20,457.00, sales tax of $2,096.84 and fees of $75.00, less my $500.00 deductible, which is $5,024.09 above the current offer.
Please send me your response in writing, including an explanation for any of the points above that you do not accept.
Thank you for your attention to claim number CLM-2026-48213.
Sincerely, Jordan Rivera
Dear Golden State Mutual Insurance Co.,
Re: Claim number CLM-2026-48213, policy number CA-AUTO-7731904, 2019 Honda Civic EX, VIN 2HGFC1F35KH654321, 48,200 mi.

Thank you for your total loss offer dated 2026-10-14, which totals $17,104.75 and uses a base value of $17,050.00; after careful review, I respectfully decline that offer and submit the counteroffer below.
For context, my own account is that another car ran a red light and hit my driver side, I was not hurt, and repairs were quoted at $9,800.

Comparable C1 does not meet the standard of similar trim, options and mileage under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), because it is an LX rather than an EX, has 61,400 mi versus my 48,200 mi, and is missing the Sunroof, Apple CarPlay and Heated Seats.
Comparable C2 is not identified by VIN, stock number or plate and has no seller contact, as required under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2).
Comparable C2 also lacks similar options under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), as it is missing the Sunroof, Apple CarPlay and Heated Seats.
Comparable C3 was not available locally within 100 miles and 90 days under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2), (b)(4)(A), because it is 214 mi away and was listed 137 days before the offer.
Comparable C3 is likewise missing the Sunroof, Apple CarPlay and Heated Seats, so it does not have similar options under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2).

The report applies a condition deduction of $1,150 even though the grade is "Average" and no documentation is provided, while 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(2) allows a condition deduction only if the vehicle is documented as below average.

Under 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(4)(A), the base value should be the average of the comparables, yet the C2 mileage adjustment of -400 has the wrong sign (52,000 vs 48,200 mi), and the average of the adjusted values is $17,266.67 rather than the $17,050.00 stated in the report.
The offer also omits prorated registration, which 10 CCR § 2695.8(b)(1) lists among the items an offer should include along with tax and fees, minus the deductible.

Current local listings show comparable 2019 Honda Civic EX FWD vehicles, including one with 27,670 mi listed at $23,047.00 by BMW of Concord 14 mi away, one with 43,394 mi listed at $15,990.00 by envision motorsport 64 mi away, one with 23,107 mi listed at $22,981.00 by Mistlin Honda 70 mi away, and one with 36,243 mi listed at $23,699.00 by Acura of Modesto 70 mi away.
Based on 11 current comparable listings, a linear fit of price on mileage indicates a market value of $20,457.00 at 48,200 mi.

Accordingly, my counteroffer totals $22,128.84, consisting of the vehicle value of $20,457.00, sales tax of $2,096.84 and fees of $75.00, less my deductible of $500.00, which is $5,024.09 above the current offer.
I respectfully request a revised offer of $22,128.84 for claim number CLM-2026-48213.
Please also provide a written response addressing each of the items above, including the C1, C2 and C3 comparables, the condition deduction, the base value calculation and the prorated registration.
Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I look forward to your reply.
Sincerely,
Jordan Rivera

I respectfully request a revised offer of $22,187.28 on claim CLM-2026-48213.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
